description: Deterministic attributes over authorized observed cross-system records. These definitions augment the summary metrics; they never assert complete company coverage from a partial collection.
rules: One subject and reporting currency per evaluation; no implied currency conversion.
Only versions observed on or before as_of are eligible; supplied duplicate versions are deduplicated and conflicts are rejected.
Snapshot fields are the supplied historical state, never reconstructed by applying current balances to an earlier as_of.
No records is unavailable, not zero. A proven empty subset of an observed population can equal zero.
Window is start-inclusive and end-exclusive. As-of and forward measures retain their period_basis and horizon in the catalog.
Money sums use exact decimal arithmetic. Division rounds to ten decimal places; p90 uses nearest rank.
No unobserved default probabilities, fraud conclusions, liquidation values, missing payroll details or historical cohort transitions are inferred.
